import json
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result

metrics={'measured_update_count':len(u),'measured_mean_update_seconds':mean,'planning_projection_200_update_hours':mean*200/3600,'projection_is_measured_result':False,'assumptions':'same Direct/tau0 short episodes and observed throughput; excludes setup/authentication/model initialization/checkpoint; actual main-training Look trajectories may differ','actual_allocation_gpu_hours':acct['metrics']['total_allocation_gpu_hours']}

'| Update | Generation s | Scoring s | Critic update s | Actor update s | Total s | Syntax parse failures / physical outputs |',
'|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|']
summ=report['metrics']['training_by_run_and_update']['smoke_e2e_T0_02']['updates']
for row in u:
 n=row['update'];s=summ[str(n)]
 lines.append('|'+str(n)+'|'+'|'.join(str(row[k]) for k in ('generation_seconds','scoring_seconds','critic_update_seconds','actor_update_seconds','total_seconds'))+'|'+str(s['physical_syntax_parse_failures'])+'/'+str(s['physical_model_outputs'])+'|')
lines+=['','The original model step3 separately recorded0/10 syntax parse failures under each of obs_never,obs_always anddiag_base;40 forced observations inobs_always are excluded from the model-output denominator. Sources: results/smoke_e2e_T0_report_02.json and its authenticated original journals.',
'','Largest recorded CUDA allocator peak allocated142252924416bytes; peak reserved163231825920bytes. Path('results',name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps({'metrics':metrics,'config':{'purpose':'explicit E2E task planning projection only; not paper result'},'sources':[tr,rr,ar]},indent=2)+'\n')
